steps.sessionName: enterprise-description-annotator: Perform ONLY the independent blind pass on ...

records.rationale: The description expressly characterizes the analytics engine as serving machine learning, an affirmative product-specific ML signal; distributed data processing and analytics remain its conventional core.
records.ai_type_rationale: Machine learning is described alongside a general-purpose distributed processing and analytics engine, indicating an AI/ML enhancement rather than a core offering dependent on it.
evidence_spans: a lightning fast unified analytics engine for big data and machine learning
ai_type_evidence_spans: a lightning fast unified analytics engine for big data and machine learning

records.rationale: The product is explicitly described as using machine learning technologies to identify, classify, and extract document content.
records.ai_type_rationale: Document capture, recognition, classification, and extraction are the described conventional core, with ML technologies supporting those functions.
evidence_spans: Its natural language processing, text analytics and machine learning technologies automatically identify, classify and extract content from unstructured or variable documents.
ai_type_evidence_spans: Its natural language processing, text analytics and machine learning technologies automatically identify, classify and extract content from unstructured or variable documents.

records.rationale: The platform expressly offers a library of machine learning algorithms, an affirmative ML signal.
records.ai_type_rationale: It is described as a broad statistical software platform with other statistical procedures and lifecycle functions; ML algorithms are one capability rather than a stated dependency of its core.
evidence_spans: a vast library of machine learning algorithms
ai_type_evidence_spans: a vast library of machine learning algorithms

records.rationale: The description explicitly says the platform uses AI-driven insights to deliver experiences.
records.ai_type_rationale: The stated core is a platform transforming data into customer profiles; AI-driven insights are an enhancement to that data/profile functionality.
evidence_spans: uses AI-driven insights to help you to deliver the right experiences across every channel.
ai_type_evidence_spans: uses AI-driven insights to help you to deliver the right experiences across every channel.

records.rationale: The offering expressly identifies its artificial-intelligence technology as measuring safe and unsafe driving behavior.
records.ai_type_rationale: The described service's central function is measuring driving behavior, and the text directly attributes that function to its AI technology.
evidence_spans: Our patented artificial intelligence (AI) technology measures safe and unsafe driving behaviors automatically, right from a driver's smartphone.
ai_type_evidence_spans: Our patented artificial intelligence (AI) technology measures safe and unsafe driving behaviors automatically, right from a driver's smartphone.

records.rationale: The product-specific description says it learns from sales activities and CRM data to identify leads and improve conversion and retention.
records.ai_type_rationale: The described Einstein offering is characterized by learning from sales/CRM data to produce its lead and sales outcomes, indicating AI is core to this offering.
evidence_spans: learns from your team's sales activities and CRM data and helps you identify the best leads, convert opportunities more efficiently, and retain customers with ease.
ai_type_evidence_spans: learns from your team's sales activities and CRM data and helps you identify the best leads, convert opportunities more efficiently, and retain customers with ease.

records.rationale: The text expressly says the text-to-speech service uses deep-learning technologies to synthesize speech.
records.ai_type_rationale: Speech synthesis is the central described function, and the description directly states deep learning is used to perform it.
evidence_spans: Polly's Text-to-Speech (TTS) service uses advanced deep learning technologies to synthesize natural sounding human speech.
ai_type_evidence_spans: Polly's Text-to-Speech (TTS) service uses advanced deep learning technologies to synthesize natural sounding human speech.

records.rationale: The description twice explicitly states the workforce-management application leverages embedded artificial-intelligence and machine-learning algorithms.
records.ai_type_rationale: The offering is a workforce management suite with reports and forecasting; embedded AI/ML are capabilities enhancing this conventional application.
evidence_spans: By leveraging embedded artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, users can identify patterns, develop accurate forecasts and generate a variety of reports.
ai_type_evidence_spans: By leveraging embedded artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, users can identify patterns, develop accurate forecasts and generate a variety of reports.

records.rationale: The description covers a data-science workbench for storing, reproducing, and reusing experiments, code and artifacts, project management, development environments, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure; it does not describe AI functionality.
evidence_spans: Domino captures all data science work in a central repository, so your team can easily find, reproduce and reuse work.
integrated project management capabilities, and the ability to replicate development environments.
streamline and enhance their data science infrastructure with scalable multi-cloud support

records.rationale: The text describes a responsive start page, device access, navigation, and management and organization of content, which are conventional interface/content functions.
evidence_spans: immersive and responsive WebFOCUS® Hub start page that allows access to every type of device, and navigation to all areas and capabilities of the platform.
manage and organize their content

records.rationale: The Secure Agent is described as running tasks and enabling secure communication through an organizational firewall, conventional agent/connectivity functionality.
evidence_spans: is a lightweight program that runs all tasks and enables secure communication across the firewall between your organization and. Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services

records.rationale: The order-to-cash platform automates invoice/payment work, consolidates data, prioritizes receivables work, and provides account visibility—conventional workflow and information-management functions.
evidence_spans: automates the manual work and consolidates the data from the moment an invoice is sent until payment is received, allowing A/R teams to prioritize their work days and have full visibility into each of their accounts at all times.

records.rationale: The description specifies browser-based connection testing and monitoring, throughput/capacity measurement, network routing and firewall tests, and analysis tools for network performance.
evidence_spans: MCS provides precise measurement connection throughput and capacity, network routing and firewall testing.

These testing parameters can be done along with its analysis tools that are custom designed to assess connections for bandwidths intensive and time critical applications such as VoIP and Video conferencing

records.rationale: This is a payment-management function that suspends payments failing validation rules and manages those suspended payments.
evidence_spans: allows suspending payments that fail validation rules and managing suspended payments.

records.rationale: The description details Salesforce mass actions, data editing and management, pipeline visibility, and workflow simplification—conventional CRM productivity functions.
evidence_spans: allowing for mass actions across multiple records.
Easily edit and manage data while accessing superior visibility into the pipeline with an improved Salesforce UX and simplified workflow.

records.rationale: The text describes EA repositories, metadata, lifecycle models, relationships among enterprise artifacts, and investment/planning use; this is conventional architecture modeling and governance functionality.
evidence_spans: They provide a central repository to capture data and metadata about the artifacts that an enterprise cares about and their related life cycles.
Models represent the relationships between these artifacts and are themselves treated as assets that help describe and shape the future of the enterprise.

records.rationale: Distributing incoming traffic across multiple targets is a conventional traffic/load distribution function, sufficiently specified without an AI-dependent signal.
evidence_spans: Distribute incoming traffic across multiple targets

records.rationale: The only text is the broad category label 'Programming Language'; it provides too little detail about the offering to establish functionality, so non-AI is a forced best judgment.
evidence_spans: Programming Language

records.rationale: 'Email support' names a support channel but supplies no meaningful description of the product functionality; the non-AI judgment is therefore forced.
evidence_spans: Email support

records.rationale: 'Modelling for 5G' is too terse to establish whether this means simulation, network planning, or another potentially AI-related function; non-AI is the best forced binary judgment.
evidence_spans: Modelling for 5G
